text:
jess: RC created: inference-api:v2.7.0-rc1 (build 3042). Release notes posted: https://redwood.company/releases/2.7.0-rc1. Change window scheduled 2024-07-21 22:00-23:00 UTC. Planning canary + traffic shift.

deploy-bot: Build 3042 uploaded to registry. Staging deploy started, running smoke tests.

sam: Looking at the notes now. Any DB migrations? Also, what model variant are we pinning to?

jess: No DB migrations in this RC. Pin model to redwood-serve-1.4.0-quant (avoids perf regressions we saw last week). Fallback: redwood-serve-1.3.5.

maya: Canary plan proposal: 5% for 30m -> 25% for 30m -> 100% after green. Health checks: P95 latency, error rate, and OOMs. Rollback thresholds: P95 increase >30% OR error rate >0.5% sustained for 10m.

arthur: Oncall will monitor initial 60m. I'll be on pager duty and reachable.

sam: Add a feature-flag kill switch for the new batching path: feature.new_batching = OFF. If latency regresses we can flip it instantly.

deploy-bot: Smoke tests passed ✅. Staging looks clean. Canary deploy scheduled at 2024-07-21T22:05:00Z.

lee: Product LGTM, I reviewed release notes and customer-facing copy. :thumbsup:

canary-bot: Canary started for inference-api:v2.7.0-rc1 -> routing 5% of traffic. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/dashboard/db/rc-2-7-0

maya: Observability hooks set. Alerts wired to #incidents and oncall email. Setting alert sensitivity to baseline+20% for this RC.

sam: Operational guardrails: if CPU > 85% on p99 nodes OR 2 OOMs within 15m -> auto rollback. Also if internal error rate > 0.5% sustained for 10m -> rollback.

deploy-bot: Planned traffic shift to 25% at 2024-07-21T22:35:00Z. Manual hold allowed before each step.

jess: Requesting formal prod sign-off from leads: @sam, @maya, @lee. Reply 'signoff' to approve.

sam: signoff

maya: signoff

lee: signoff. Note: watch customer rate-limited endpoints during the first 30m.

canary-bot: 25% traffic shift complete (now 65m into canary). No firing alerts so far.

deploy-bot: Conditions met for promotion. Starting gradual shift to 100% over 30m.

canary-bot: Promotion complete — inference-api:v2.7.0-rc1 at 100% traffic.

arthur: Monitoring post-promote metrics. No regressions observed in the first 45m.

jess: Release notes published and pinned in docs. RC thread resolved. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround. :party_parrot:
